exclusions: Native protein-aligned ligand RMSD: source reference/fit masks unresolved
Native COM/SASA/energy cross-dataset equivalence: mass/mask/probe/energy conventions unresolved
MISATO physical-time mapping: no verified source timestamps/export cadence
MISATO periodic repair: box metadata absent; no assumed cell
Cross-dataset region equivalence: MISATO lacks admitted protein residue/CA identity
General physical-contact or allostery claim: raw geometric definitions do not establish those interpretations
followup_requirements: Every new source must pass topology/selection/checksum/time verification before extraction
Preserve the raw-Cartesian feature version; any imaging change gets a new definition and experiment
Compare source cadence in separate grids; do not convert MISATO frame counts to invented ps
Keep original cohorts as development evidence and reserve new confirmation systems
Source coordinate/trajectory bytes and full acquired metadata stay ignored; constituent redistribution rights are not inferred from record licenses
